title: Visit to the Antikythera mechanism

tellings.quote: I recently went to Athens, Greece to see the the Antikythera mechanism.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property where he says on the show there is a UFO under the ground, tells Michels that he recently travelled to Athens, Greece, to see the Antikythera mechanism, an ancient geared device. He tells it as his own trip, made out of interest in what ancient people may have known or built.
